scope: The exact 40 published corridor estates missing an exterior at the baseline tip. No publication or DB state is changed.
method: Bounded research of all 40 using primary Wikimedia Commons file/category pages, English/Chinese and alias queries, relevant street categories, and author/CC alternatives. Incidental property-portal search results were excluded and no competitor image was fetched or copied.
verificationLimits: Author, date, own-work license, exact estate subject and selected thumbnail URL checked against primary file pages.

A thumbnail open returned only a text ImageDisplayed marker and its URL, not image pixels. Image-response observation does not establish pixel composition, browser/social-crawler loading, or native visual verification.
Category membership alone did not qualify generic road/neighbourhood photos. Bayview Terrace remains missing pending actual composition review.
Missing means no qualifying image found in this bounded pass, not that none exists.
